proof_scope: In progress. R1761 completes quantitative near-identity Mobius control and reuses Mathlib for actual change of variables. MobiusCalculus proves the derivative formula, its positivity and continuity, measurable images, the real image-measure integral formula, and the exact squared-integral identity for the square-root-Jacobian weighted pullback on measurable subsets of the existing rational interval. It proves both inverse compositions on the unit interval, the reciprocal derivative identity, and the unit-restricted preimage/inverse-image equality under its explicit domain hypothesis. NearIdentityMobius bounds coefficients entrywise by eta, transfers the condition to the adjugate inverse, and derives it from squared coefficient distance at most eta^2. For eta<=1/8 and x in [0,1], the denominator lies between 1-2eta and 1+2eta, displacement is at most 8eta, and derivative and square-root-derivative errors are at most 32eta. These imply actual image-measure distortion between factors 1-32eta and 1+32eta. A central interval [r,1-r] with r>=8eta lies in the clipped domain and maps into [0,1], for the map and its inverse. The corresponding preimage identity is proved. These local identities do not by themselves establish a unitary L2 representation, almost-invariance, the spectral gap, or generator existence.
